name: UploadFilesToFtp
label: Upload File to FTP
description: Uploads a single file to an FTP server.

fields.name: FtpConnection
fields.label: FTP Connection
fields.description: The FtpClient object representing an open connection to an FTP server.

fields.name: LocalFile
fields.label: Local File
fields.description: The local file path to upload.

fields.name: RemoteDirectory
fields.label: Remote Directory
fields.description: The remote directory where the file should be uploaded.

fields.name: OverwriteMode
fields.label: Overwrite Mode
fields.description: Specifies when to overwrite the file on the server.

selectOptions.label: If newer
selectOptions.description: Overwrite if remote file is newer.

selectOptions.label: If newer or size different
selectOptions.description: Overwrite if remote is newer or size differs.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait before failing due to timeout.

fields.name: UploadedFilesCount
fields.label: Uploaded Files Count
fields.description: Returns the number of files successfully uploaded (0 or 1).

fields.name: SkippedFiles
fields.label: Skipped Files
fields.description: Returns the list containing the file that was skipped during upload, if any.
